name: Gästehaus Elfriede
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Elfriede in Gerlos is a traditional inn. The accommodation is located in the center of Gerlos, near the valley station of the gondola lift. The atmosphere is shaped by the rural surroundings and the typical Tiroler style. Guests can expect simple but clean and functional furnishings. The surrounding area offers a wide range of hiking and skiing opportunities directly from the house. The inn has a restaurant serving regional cuisine. The rooms are equipped with a bathroom, WC, and balcony. The house also offers a ski cellar and free parking.
